# Airbnb

> > Global vacation rental marketplace and travel platform offering homes, experiences, and services, led by Brian Chesky and team.

Airbnb connects travelers with unique accommodations worldwide and has expanded beyond lodging with Airbnb Services and Airbnb Experiences. The 2025 Summer Release marks a significant platform evolution, introducing in-home services and a redesigned app to create a comprehensive travel and lifestyle marketplace.

## Core Platform

- [United States Vacation Rentals (5 out of 5) - Airbnb](https://www.airbnb.com/united-states/stays/vacation-homes): United States vacation home rentals search and booking page
- [Earn with Airbnb-friendly apartments](https://www.airbnb.com/airbnb-friendly): Airbnb-friendly apartments program for hosting without ownership
- [Offer your service on Airbnb](https://www.airbnb.com/host/services): Service provider onboarding for Airbnb Services marketplace
